title: Mastery of Subversion
summary: Recover enough seals to challenge the Master of Subversion.
overview: Recover enough seals to challenge the Master of Subversion.

phases.label: Recover seals
phases.description: Gather copper, silver and gold seals to reach the required total.

phases.label: The master
phases.description: Prepare to defeat the now-vulnerable Master of Subversion.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Collect seals until their combined value reaches 300 points.
Copper, silver and gold seals contribute 10, 20 and 30 points respectively.
Avoid unnecessary fighting while gathering, then prepare to defeat the master when the required total is reached.

notes: Reviewed quest source; behavior, balance, spawns and completion have not been verified in a live instance.
This document applies to instance version 1.
